Description: Requirement: The system shall allow a visitor to register an account with a unique email, name, and a password meeting complexity rules. Acceptance Criteria: AC-001 Duplicate email is rejected; weak password rejected. Test: TC-Auth-01

Requirement: The system shall authenticate registered users via email and password, storing only salted-hashed passwords. Acceptance Criteria: AC-002 Correct credentials create a session; wrong password denied. Test: TC-Auth-02
Requirement: The system shall allow a user to reset a forgotten password via a time-limited email link. Acceptance Criteria: AC-003 Link expires after 30 min; reused link rejected. Test: TC-Auth-03

Requirement: The system shall let a user view and edit their profile and manage multiple shipping addresses. Acceptance Criteria: AC-004 Edited profile persists and default address is usable at checkout. Test: TC-Auth-04

Requirement: The system shall let any visitor browse the book catalog by category/genre without logging in. Acceptance Criteria: AC-005 Category page lists all active listings in that category. Test: TC-Cat-01

Requirement: The system shall provide keyword search across title, author, and ISBN with pagination. Acceptance Criteria: AC-006 Search for a known title returns it within top results in <2s. Test: TC-Cat-02

Requirement: The system shall display a book detail page showing price, condition, seller, stock, and description. Acceptance Criteria: AC-007 Detail page renders all fields for any active listing. Test: TC-Cat-03

Requirement: The system shall allow filtering and sorting of search/browse results by price, rating, and availability. Acceptance Criteria: AC-008 Sorting by price ascending reorders results correctly. Test: TC-Cat-04

Requirement: The system shall allow a verified seller to create a book listing with title, author, ISBN, price, condition, cover image, and stock count. Acceptance Criteria: AC-009 Listing is created with mandatory fields validated and appears in active listings. Test: TC-List-01

Requirement: The system shall allow a verified seller to edit an existing listing's details (price, condition, stock, description). Acceptance Criteria: AC-010 Edited fields persist and are reflected on the live listing immediately. Test: TC-List-02

Requirement: The system shall allow a verified seller to remove (deactivate) an existing listing, and automatically flag duplicate or suspicious listings. Acceptance Criteria: AC-011 Removed listing no longer appears in catalog; duplicate raises moderation flag. Test: TC-List-03

Requirement: The system shall provide sellers with a dashboard summarising active listings, order status, and earnings. Acceptance Criteria: AC-012 Dashboard totals match underlying records. Test: TC-List-04

Requirement: The system shall allow a buyer to add and remove books from a persistent shopping cart that survives across sessions. Acceptance Criteria: AC-013 Cart contents persist after logout/login; removed items no longer counted. Test: TC-Cart-01

Requirement: The system shall allow a buyer to apply a valid coupon/discount code at checkout and reject expired codes. Acceptance Criteria: AC-014 Valid code reduces total; invalid code rejected with message. Test: TC-Cart-02

Requirement: The system shall allow a buyer to select a saved shipping address or add a new one during checkout. Acceptance Criteria: AC-015 Address is attached to order at checkout confirmation. Test: TC-Cart-03

Requirement: The system shall allow a buyer to complete payment through an integrated payment gateway (card/UPI/wallet). Acceptance Criteria: AC-016 Successful payment generates confirmed order; failed leaves cart intact. Test: TC-Pay-01

Requirement: The system shall generate an order confirmation and a downloadable invoice immediately upon successful payment. Acceptance Criteria: AC-017 Downloadable invoice PDF matches line items and totals. Test: TC-Ord-01

Requirement: The system shall allow a buyer to track order status through defined stages (Placed/Shipped/Out for Delivery/Delivered). Acceptance Criteria: AC-018 Status shown matches latest shipping-partner update. Test: TC-Ord-02

Requirement: The system shall allow a buyer to request cancellation or return within a configurable policy window (7 days). Acceptance Criteria: AC-019 Request within window accepted; request after window rejected. Test: TC-Ord-03

Requirement: The system shall allow a buyer who completed a purchase to rate and review the book and seller. Acceptance Criteria: AC-020 Review accepted only from verified buyers with completed orders. Test: TC-Rev-01

Requirement: The system shall compute and display aggregate rating for each book and seller, recalculated on new submissions. Acceptance Criteria: AC-021 Displayed average matches recalculation from stored ratings. Test: TC-Rev-02

Requirement: The system shall allow an administrator to moderate flagged listings and reports (approve/reject/remove). Acceptance Criteria: AC-022 Moderation updates status and records audit log entry. Test: TC-Admin-01

Requirement: The system shall allow an admin to suspend/verify accounts and view sales analytics dashboard. Acceptance Criteria: AC-023 Suspended account cannot log in; dashboard totals reconcile with orders. Test: TC-Admin-02
Requirement: Page load and search response shall complete within 3 seconds for 90% of requests under normal load. Acceptance Criteria: 90th percentile <= 3s in load test. Test: TC-Perf-01
Requirement: The platform shall provide 99.5% monthly uptime excluding scheduled maintenance. Acceptance Criteria: Uptime monitoring reports >= 99.5%/month. Test: Ops reports

Requirement: All cardholder and payment data shall be handled per PCI-DSS; raw card numbers never stored in application DB. Acceptance Criteria: PCI-DSS checklist pass; tokenisation verified. Test: TC-Sec-01
Requirement: UI shall be responsive and usable on mobile, tablet, and desktop (WCAG 2.1 AA where practical). Acceptance Criteria: Responsive layout audit + accessibility scan pass. Test: TC-UX-01
Requirement: System architecture shall support horizontal scaling of catalog and order services. Acceptance Criteria: Load test shows linear throughput gain when instance is added. Test: TC-Scale-01
Requirement: TLS 1.2+ mandatory for all client-server and server-to-payment connections. Acceptance Criteria: TLS scan confirms no plaintext endpoints. Test: TC-Sec-02
Requirement: User passwords stored only as salted cryptographic hashes (bcrypt/Argon2). Acceptance Criteria: DB inspection shows hashed values only. Test: TC-Sec-03
Requirement: Payment details tokenised by payment gateway; application never persists full card numbers or CVV. Acceptance Criteria: Code/DB review confirms no raw PAN storage. Test: TC-Sec-04
Requirement: Lock account for 15 minutes after 5 consecutive failed login attempts and log event. Acceptance Criteria: Automated attempt triggers lockout and audit entry. Test: TC-Sec-05
Requirement: All user-supplied input validated and sanitised on client and server (XSS and injection prevention). Acceptance Criteria: OWASP ZAP scan shows no high-severity findings. Test: TC-Sec-06
